confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Edinburgh price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak tourist season and Festival-period demand can push room rates well above typical levels. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates, not derived from beer. FX caveat: the RBA observation came from search-result text and I did not open the RBA page to verify it. It is dated 2026-03-20, about seven months before the 2026-10-15 generation date, so it may not be the latest RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against typical price levels in mid-sized UK and Northern European visitor cities, adjusted for Edinburgh's high-season hotel demand. No specific comparable city was checked against live data.
